name: P. L. Travers
contribution: An Australian-British writer who spent most of her career in England.

checks.lead: Pamela Lyndon Travers  ( TRAV-ərz; born Helen Lyndon Goff; 9 August 1899 – 23 April 1996) was an Australian-British writer who spent most of her career in England. She is best known for the Mary Poppins series of books, which feature the eponymous magical nanny.
